info.name: GitLab Webhooks API
info.description:
The GitLab Webhooks API provides REST endpoints for managing project and group webhooks. Webhooks can be configured to send HTTP POST requests to external URLs when events occur in GitLab, such as pushes, merge requests, issues, pipelines, and deployments. This API covers webhook configuration, event history, and test trigger operations.

Contact Support:
 Name: GitLab Support
